question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa concludes with this colophon?
premises: The colophon names the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text.
It identifies the chapter on neck ornament characteristics.
It states the chapter number as nineteen.
inference: This marks the end of the nineteenth chapter on neck ornament characteristics.
plain_english: Thus ends the nineteenth chapter, on the characteristics of neck ornaments, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
